items.title: Finite presentation maps admit a relative Noetherian stratification over which the source is flat
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S of finite presentation between quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, there exist t >= 0 and closed subschemes S = S_0 superset S_1 superset ... superset S_t = empty (each S_i -> S defined by a finite type ideal sheaf, S_0 a thickening of S) such that X times_S (S_i minus S_{i+1}) is flat over S_i minus S_{i+1} for each i. The retained proof is written: apply the chapter's module-level generic flatness stratification lemma (generic-flatness-stratification, registered by lane S9 as S9-morph-generic-flatness-stratification) with the structure sheaf F = O_X, whose stratified flatness for the module O_X over the locally closed strata is exactly the claimed flatness of the strata of X. Retained author proof at lines 15627-15630.
